name: Minegishi Yukiko
source:
An ordinary mother who has a 3 year old daughter. Moved to this neighborhood recently. She's gentle, meek, and is a pacifist. She's the type who can't say what's in her mind, and just goes with the flow. 

As her husband is busy with work, they only have sex once or so every month. Because of that, she's sexually unsatisfied. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/momo_hina/kouen/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
